message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The case: theft of 7 guihua trees (桂花树) valued 5400 yuan. They dug up trees from a company's orchard, stole them, later recovered. The defendant Zhang voluntarily surrendered (self-report). So crime: theft (盗窃). Possibly also "非法占有" is theft. The value 5400 yuan is considered "数额较大" (relatively large). So the charge is theft. No other crimes like damage, etc. They used digging method, but still theft. So answer: [罪名]盗窃<eoa>.

Check if any other crimes: maybe "破坏财物" because they damaged trees? But they stole whole trees, not just damage. The crime is theft of property (trees). So just theft.

Thus final answer JSON with reasoning and final answer.
